jd:
At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com.

As guided by Our Credo, Johnson & Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson & Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.

Job Function

Career Programs

Job Sub Function

Non-LDP Intern/Co-Op

Job Category

Career Program

All Job Posting Locations:

Cambridge, Massachusetts, United States of America, La Jolla, California, United States of America, Leiden, Netherlands, Titusville, New Jersey, United States of America, Zug, Switzerland

Job Description

Summer intern, Digital Signal/ Imaging AI

Position Components

In this role, you will work with colleagues in the J&J Innovative Medicine R&D Data, Data Science, and AI (DDSAI) organization and partner with key businesses across J&J Innovative Medicine to apply advanced data science and analytics to answer key research questions. As an intern, you will get the opportunity to work on cutting-edge problems at the intersection of AI and healthcare. You will be a member of a dynamic team comprising data scientists and subject matter experts to create and iterate on data science solutions. Projects include, but are not limited to, processing and analysis of wearable sensor and neuroimaging data, development of machine learning models for digital biomarker discovery, validation of digital health endpoints, generation of insights from real-world physiological and behavioral data, modeling and prediction of disease severity and progression, and discovering of disease subtypes. Interns could be located out of our US locations in San Diego CA, San Francisco CA, Titusville NJ, Raritan NJ, Spring House PA, Cambridge MA, or out of Europe locations in Beerse (Belgium), Leiden (The Netherlands), Zug (Switzerland) as well as remote.

Minimum Qualifications



- Currently pursuing a PhD degree in Biomedical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Neuroscience, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, or a related quantitative discipline.
- Strong working knowledge of AI and machine learning.
- Advanced in Python or R
- Strong skills in predictive modeling, statistics, and analysis of large datasets.
- Strong technical communication and presentation skills.
- Basic knowledge of data cleaning and data quality

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in one or more of the following:



- Experience with processing and analyzing sensor, wearable device, clinical records, and/or medical imaging data.
- Proficiency with pytorch.
- Experience with semi-supervised and/or self-supervised learning.
- Experience with Foundation Models

Permanently authorized to work in the U.S., must not require sponsorship of an employment visa (e.g., H-1B or green card) at the time of application or in the future. Students currently on CPT, OPT, or STEM OPT usually requires future sponsorship for long term employment and do not meet the requirements for this program unless eligible for an alternative long-term status that does not require company sponsorship.

Johnson & Johnson is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by federal, state or local law. We actively seek qualified candidates who are protected veterans and individuals with disabilities as defined under VEVRAA and Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act.

Johnson & Johnson is committed to providing an interview process that is inclusive of our applicants’ needs. If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request an accommodation, external applicants please contact us via https://www.jnj.com/contact-us/careers . Internal employees contact AskGS to be directed to your accommodation resource.

Introduction

At IBM Software, we transform client challenges into solutions. Building the world's leading AI-powered, cloud-native products that shape the future of business and society. Our legacy of innovation creates endless opportunities for IBMers to learn, grow, and make an impact on a global scale. Working in Software means joining a team fueled by curiosity and collaboration. You'll work with diverse technologies, partners, and industries to design, develop, and deliver solutions that power digital transformation. With a culture that values innovation, growth, and continuous learning, IBM Software places you at the heart of IBM's product and technology landscape. Here, you'l have the tools and opportunities to advance your career while creating software that changes the world.

Your Role And Responsibilities

This is a 16‑week Co‑Op position designed for actively enrolled undergraduate students who are interested in gaining hands‑on, practical experience in their field while contributing to real IBM projects. To be eligible, candidates must be currently enrolled at an accredited university and able to pause their coursework for the duration of the Co‑Op, as students may not be enrolled in classes while participating. This role requires full‑time availability (40 hours per week) during the Spring 2027 semester between Jan 19 - May 7. Eligible candidates should also be available to join IBM in a full‑time role between December 2027 and August 2028 upon successful completion of their degree.

Build AI for the systems the world relies on. At IBM Z, our technology supports the transactions and data behind banking, payments, and global commerce. We are bringing AI into that foundation to help developers build faster, simplify complex operations, and solve problems where reliability, security, and performance matter.

As an AI Software Engineer Intern, you will work alongside experienced engineers to turn advances in large language models into useful software. Depending on your team, you could build an agent that helps diagnose system issues, connect AI to enterprise data and tools, or create a simpler way for developers to work with complex systems. Bring your ideas, experiment, and help take a feature from prototype through testing and refinement.

What You’ll Do



- Design, build, and test AI-powered features that address real developer and client needs, with guidance from experienced engineers.
- Integrate LLMs, APIs, and enterprise data into applications, exploring agent workflows, tool calling, and retrieval where they fit the problem.
- Write clear specifications and effective prompts, use AI development tools thoughtfully, and review and test the code they produce.
- Evaluate AI behavior with realistic test cases, measure quality and performance, and improve how applications handle incorrect outputs and failures.
- Debug across model interactions, application code, APIs, and underlying systems to understand root causes and build reliable solutions.
- Collaborate through Git, code reviews, and technical discussions; document your work and iterate on feedback.

Location Flexibility: By applying to this requisition, you acknowledge and agree to be considered for any of the listed locations associated with this position and are willing to work at the location where you are ultimately assigned.

Preferred Education

Bachelor's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise



- Must be actively enrolled in a Bachelor’s degree program at the time of application and returning to complete the degree after the co-op. 
- Available to start full-time between December 2027 and August 2028. 
- Available to work full-time (40 hours/week) at an IBM location for 16 weeks between Jan 19 - May 7. 
- Co-op requires a full-time commitment; students should not be enrolled in concurrent coursework during the co-op term. 
- Strong software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, software design, and testing.
- Proficiency in Python and experience building applications or services that integrate APIs.
- Hands-on experience building an application or working prototype with LLMs. You can explain what you built, how you integrated the model, and how you tested its behavior. Experience may come from personal, academic, open-source, or internship projects.
- A systematic debugging mindset: you can investigate failures, test assumptions, and reason about how application code, data, models, and underlying systems interact.
- Ability to translate a problem into clear requirements, prompts, and testable acceptance criteria, and critically evaluate AI-generated code and responses.
- Familiarity with Git, clear technical communication, and the ability to learn quickly and collaborate on a team.

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience



- Experience in one or more of the following areas is a plus. You do not need experience with every technology listed.
- AI agents and tool or function calling; retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, vector databases, or Model Context Protocol (MCP).
- Independent AI projects, open-source contributions, or experiments beyond assigned coursework that demonstrate initiative and thoughtful engineering decisions.
- Additional programming experience in JavaScript/TypeScript or Go, and familiarity with distributed systems or microservices.
- Operating system concepts such as concurrency, multithreading, and memory management; relational databases and SQL.
- Cloud and container technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, or OpenShift; observability, search, or real-time data processing tools such as OpenSearch or Kafka.
- AI evaluation, anomaly detection, or experience measuring and improving model accuracy, latency, and reliability.

We are especially interested in what you have built and learned. Where available, include a project link, repository, demo, or a brief description of your contribution and the technical challenges you worked through.
fit_why: LLM/RAG integration, Python APIs, full-stack: strong match for co-op

Our mission 
 At Healthpeak, we give our  Forward Deployed Software Engineers  the autonomy of a startup with the backing, scope, and staying power of a well‑established organization. We exist to transform technology into a revenue‑generating arm of the real estate business, building products and platforms that directly support our tenants, partners, and the teams who serve them every day. We are looking for interns to join us for  Summer 2027 ! 

 As an FDSE, you will be part of a small, agile pod and will directly embed with business teams. You will work side‑by‑side with operators, asset managers, and customer‑facing colleagues to rapidly identify opportunities, design solutions, and deliver real value. This is a hands‑on, high‑impact role for engineers who thrive close to users, enjoy ambiguity, and want to see their work make a tangible difference. 

 You will relentlessly prototype, test, launch, and scale new ideas—often moving from concept to production in the matter of weeks. Our first and most important customers are our peers inside Healthpeak, and our ultimate goal is to create delightful, seamless experiences for our tenants and partners by relentlessly minimizing friction. 

 What we’re looking for 
• Inquisitive engineers who care just as much about why we’re building it as how it should be built. Those who dare to reimagine how work can be done. 
• Proven programming expertise across languages such as Python, Java, C++, and TypeScript/JavaScript, with hands-on experience developing alongside AI agents (e.g., Claude Code). Backgrounds in Computer Science, Mathematics, Software Engineering, Physics, or Data Science are especially relevant. 
• Strong technical problem-solving skills, including practical experience with data structures, storage systems, cloud infrastructure, front-end frameworks, and related technologies. 
• Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, thriving in fast-paced environments with evolving goals and iterative user feedback. 
• Self-directed and adaptable learner, capable of working independently and making sound decisions with minimal oversight. 
• Expected hours: 40 hrs per week over 12 weeks 
• Pay rate: $25/hr
fit_why: Full-stack web work with Python/TS, startup-style pod, matches his stack

jd:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com http://OpenGov.com.




JOB SUMMARY

OpenGov is on a mission to power a more effective and accountable government — and the software our engineering teams ship every day makes that real for thousands of public agencies across the country. As a Software Engineering Intern, you'll contribute to production features used by real customers, working side by side with full-time engineers across the full stack. This is a hands-on internship where you'll write code that ships, not code that sits in a sandbox. Expect to leave with a deeper understanding of how modern SaaS engineering teams build, test, and deliver enterprise-grade software at scale.

 


RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Build and ship features across our production codebase, contributing to web applications and APIs that serve government customers every day

 - Design, document, and implement REST API endpoints in collaboration with senior engineers, learning how scalable service contracts are built and maintained

 - Write unit and integration tests alongside feature work, developing habits around code quality and test coverage from day one

 - Participate in code reviews — both receiving and giving feedback — to sharpen your craft and understand how the team maintains a high bar for quality

 - Collaborate with engineers during sprint planning, standups, and retrospectives to experience the full rhythm of an agile engineering team

 - Investigate and resolve bugs and performance issues, tracing problems through the stack to develop debugging instincts in a real production environment

 - Explore AI-assisted development tools to accelerate your workflow and get exposure to how modern engineering teams are integrating AI into their day-to-day

 


REQUIREMENTS AND PREFERRED EXPERIENCE


REQUIREMENTS:

 - Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent program

 - Proficiency in at least one modern programming language (TypeScript, JavaScript, React, or Node)

 - Experience building with AI-driven UX, agents, and workflow automation (direct ML experience not required)

 - Ability to collaborate effectively in a team environment and communicate clearly about technical problems

 - Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail — you spot edge cases and ask good questions

 - Curiosity and a self-starter mindset; eager to learn from feedback and iterate quickly


PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

 - Familiarity with front-end frameworks such as Angular, React, or Redux

 - Basic experience with Git or similar version control tools

 - Personal or open-source projects you're proud of — GitHub link welcome

 - Strong written or verbal communication skills; bonus if you've shared your work via blogs, talks, or demos

 - GPA 3.0+

 


COMPENSATION:

Boston, MA: $30 per hour 

 

On target ranges above include base plus a portion of variable compensation that is earned based on company and individual performance.

 

The final compensation will be determined by a number of factors such as qualifications, expertise, and the candidate’s geographical location.




WHY OPENGOV?



A Mission That Matters. 

At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust.  Some people say this is boring.  We think it’s the core of our democracy.



Opportunity to Innovate

The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.



A Team of Passionate, Driven People

This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.



A Place to Make Your Mark

We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.



Benefits That Work for You

Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:

 - Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families

 - Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays

 - 401(k) with company match

 - Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions

 - Professional development and growth opportunities

 - A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.
fit_why: Full-stack TypeScript/React/Node web apps; REST APIs, tests, CI match

We are Covestro. We are curious. We are courageous. We are colorful. We refine chemical material solutions with game-changing products. Let us empower you to push boundaries. Join us and our 18,000 colleagues now and together we will make the world a brighter place.  
 
 Covestro is a world-leading supplier of high-tech polymer materials. Our Shanghai site represents one of our largest global production facilities, with the Supply Chain and Logistics Center of Excellence playing a crucial role in maintaining efficient operations across the Asia Pacific region.

 WHAT WE OFFER 
 We are seeking a motivated Supply Chain Data Full Stack Developer Co-op to join our Supply Chain and Logistics Digital and AI Team in Pittsburgh. This role will support business analytics and process improvement projects by collecting, validating, and cleaning data, as well as coding for project development, while assisting with project administration and documentation. 

 This role offers hands-on experience within a global supply chain organization, combined with exposure to advanced analytics projects in an international setting. You'll benefit from mentorship by experienced supply chain professionals while contributing to meaningful projects that deliver real business impact — all with direct insight into Covestro's digital transformation initiatives in supply chain.

 An Ideal candidate would be a motivated and eager to learn student looking for a collaborative work environment to gain experience. Planned start dates would in either the Spring or Summer of 2027 depending on availability.  This role is designed to be three total rotations and end of semester reviews may lead to future return offers for more co-op rotations if both the student and Covestro feel it is a good fit. 

 Key Responsibilities: 
 ·         Assist in business analytics projects focusing on supply chain optimization
 ·         Collect, validate, and clean data from various sources
 ·         Help prepare project documentation, user requirement documents, and user manuals
 ·         Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather and analyze supply chain data
 ·         Support senior developers with the development, deployment and maintenance of full stack tools built for the various supply chain groups
 ·         Develop scripts for automations and optimization models
 ·         Contribute to process improvement initiatives within the SC&L DAI Team

 WHAT YOU OFFER 

 Basic Qualifications: 
 ·         Currently enrolled in undergraduate studies and completion of freshman year (at time of start date)
 ·         Pursuing a degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering or Electrical Engineering

 Preferred Qualifications: 
 ·         Completion of sophomore year (at time of start date)
 ·         Experience working with Python or Typescript
 ·         Pursuing a minor or certificate in business or supply chain related fields
 ·         Familiarity with agentic coding tools
 ·         Exposure to Amazon Web Services (AWS) or other similar cloud computing platforms

 Knowledge and Skills: 
 ·         Strong analytical skills and attention to detail
 ·         Proficiency in data analysis tools and Microsoft Office suite
 ·         Good communication skills in English
 ·         Ability to work in a team environment
 ·         Interest in supply chain operations and logistics
 
 YOUR APPLICATION 
 Are you as curious, courageous and colorful as we are? If so, we can offer you an exciting career opportunity. We look forward to receiving your application and resume. Become part of our team - apply now!

THE FIRM 
 
 As a leading international law firm, we are dedicated to excellence through impactful communication, collaboration, and community involvement. Our company culture has earned us one of the "100 Best Companies to Work For" for 27 consecutive years. This honor, along with many others, highlights our commitment to innovation and professional development. At Alston & Bird LLP, our foundation is made of trust, reliability, and compassion.
 
 JOB DESCRIPTION 
 
 Alston & Bird’s Information Technology team is seeking a Developer Intern to join our office. This internship provides hands-on experience supporting software development initiatives and technology solutions that serve the firm’s attorneys and business professionals.

 Duties, among others, include assisting with application development, testing, troubleshooting technical issues, documenting processes, and supporting system enhancements. The Developer Intern will collaborate with developers, business analysts, and end users while gaining exposure to the full software development lifecycle.

 This is a collaborative position requiring strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. The ideal candidate is a motivated self-starter pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or a related field, with a passion for technology and software development.

 ESSENTIAL DUTIES 

• Assist in the design, development, and testing of mobile and web applications for use across all areas of the firm.  
• Support data science initiatives by cleaning, analyzing, and visualizing data to uncover insights.  
• Collaborate on the configuration and deployment of AI tools like Microsoft Copilot Studio and Azure OpenAI.  
• Documentation, technical write-ups, and internal training materials.  
• Attend team meetings and brainstorming sessions to share ideas and learn from senior staff. 
• Collaborate with firm users and clients to assess business needs and recommend/design modern digital solutions. 
• Become familiar with all firm applications and solutions that can be used in a solution design to meet requirements, including but not limited to SharePoint Online, Power Apps, Power Automate, and Power BI. 
• Leverage AI tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI services) to enhance solution capabilities and user experience. 
• Integrate applications and data across platforms using APIs, connectors, and cloud services. 
• Attend meetings with users, stakeholders, and colleagues to align goals and progress. 
• Perform additional duties as requested. 
 SKILLS NEEDED TO BE SUCESSFUL 

• Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.  
• Basic understanding of machine learning concepts and mobile app development.  
• Exposure to Microsoft 365 tools and interest in generative AI platforms like Copilot.  
• Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and willingness to learn.  
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills. 
• Experience with programming languages such as JavaScript, TypeScript, C#, or Python. 
• Understanding of networking, server management, and cloud storage (e.g., Azure, OneDrive). 
• Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities. 
• Strong attention to detail and ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment.
  
 EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER 
 
 Alston & Bird LLP is an Equal Opportunity Employer does not discriminate on the bases of any status protected under federal, state, or local law. Applicants will be considered regardless of their sex, race, age, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition (associated with cancer, a history of cancer, or genetic characteristics), HIV/AIDS status, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, military and veteran status, or other protected category under the law on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, national origin, veteran status or disability in relation to our recruiting, hiring, and promoting practices.

jd:
Overview

 Lutron is seeking an Software Engineering Co-Op to join our collaborative team and contribute to high-impact projects. In this role, you will help design and deliver software driven solutions that power smart lighting and shading systems. At Lutron, your interest in application software development will grow through hands-on experience, practical skill-building, and collaboration with experienced application software engineers in a supportive environment. 

 We consider co-ops to be very valuable in our search for exceptional future members of our team and pride ourselves in providing outstanding work experience to students from a wide variety of universities and backgrounds. 

 Responsibilities

 Your co-op at Lutron could offer you the opportunity to work on: 

• Software design, development, and testing 

• Code reviews and technical discussions 

• Software debugging, testing and tracing 

• Driving active projects in partnership with cross functional teams 

• Learning and applying newly adopted tools and technologies to enhance system performance, reliability, and scalability 

 Qualifications

 We seek talented, success-minded people with the desire and ability to make things happen. Our baseline requirements are simple: 

• You are pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Software Engineering 

• Your cumulative GPA is at least 3.20 

• You are a rising junior, rising senior, or master's student at the start of the co-op

• You have broad interests in application software, design and development 

• You are authorized to work in the U.S. and will not require Lutron to sponsor you for any work visa, such as an H-1B, either immediately or at any time in the future. Lutron does not offer work visa sponsorship for this position. 

• Willingness and ability to work on-site 5 days per week 

 Lutron is a team-oriented environment, and you will work within these teams to look at broad issues and identify root causes, not just quick fixes. You must have a willingness to ask tough questions, seek out new resources and work hard to find the best solution. 

 Here is what you can expect from our co-op program: 

• Competitive pay 

• Housing resources 

• Meaningful project-based work 

• Mentorship 

• Experiential learning 

• Shadowing opportunities 

• Collaborative, cross-functional teams 

• Networking opportunities 

• Social events

 Starting pay: $30.75 to $45.25 per hour plus transition support. 

 Lutron Electronics’ position as the worldwide leader in innovative lighting control and shading solutions has enabled consistent, annual growth. Our company has cultivated a reputation of unsurpassed quality, a broad range of technologies and product offerings, and a strong commitment to servicing our worldwide customers. This has allowed the company to invest in developing new technologies and services, expand our technical capabilities and global presence, and to find and retain the best talent.  Build your career with Lutron where you will enjoy competitive compensation and benefits while exploring many options for continued growth and education. Make a difference every day in our dynamic, people-centric, technology-driven organization. For more information, view our website at  www.lutron.com.

 Lutron Electronics is an Equal Opportunity – Affirmative Action – Employer. We welcome qualified, motivated applicants regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability or genetics

role: Software Engineer Internship – Technology Health Plan
jd:
Why choose an internship with Wellmark? During our 2027 Summer Internship Program, you’ll apply what you’ve learned in school to meaningful work that supports the team and builds your professional experience. You’ll gain hands-on exposure to the health insurance industry, learn from subject matter experts and leaders, and connect with fellow internship program participants.
 If you’re eager to learn, collaborate with others, demonstrate your potential, develop customer-focused solutions, and grow into an exciting career, we hope you’ll consider an internship with us!

What’s Application Development in our Technology Division? At a time when technology is creating new business models, disrupting industries and creating valuable experiences for consumers, our role as technology team members must elevate an organization through innovative transformation, modernized technology and delivery of new business strategies, including an aim to continuously evolve and enhance the customer experience. As an intern, you’ll contribute to real-world projects involving application modernization, user experience, and process improvement.
 What projects might I support?  Although subject to change, examples of projects you will be contributing to include:
 
• Support the conversion and modernization of existing SOAP/REST APIs, gaining hands-on experience with application architecture, integrations, and modern development practices. 
• Identify and implement enhancements to existing user interfaces to improve usability, functionality, and the overall user experience. 
• Design, build, and test new features and functionality within existing user interfaces based on business and user needs. 
• Contribute to modernization initiatives by evaluating existing application components and assisting with updates that improve maintainability, functionality, and user experience. 
• Help design and develop a new tool to support data comparison or mapping, including defining requirements, building functionality, and testing the solution. 
• Learn the medical product configuration process and contribute to opportunities to improve or streamline supporting tools, workflows, or processes. Ready to bring your strengths to Wellmark? Review the qualifications below and submit your application if this internship aligns with your skills and interests.
